14d59476c1a3f724.en: Medical workers. I am not asking the reception employee to diagnose me.
14d59476c1a3f724.zh: 由医务人员判断。我不是要求接待人员给我诊断。

7ab9d68e7b7bef2b.en: Who will determine what kind of help is needed?
7ab9d68e7b7bef2b.zh: 由谁判断需要哪种救助？

5399616366333e26.en: Duty reception employee at a health authority
5399616366333e26.zh: 卫生主管机关接待处值班人员

3ec4039c32aabe84.en: Contact medical help first; afterwards handle the ordinary submission within the reception office's authority.
3ec4039c32aabe84.zh: 先联系医疗救助；随后在接待处权限内处理普通来函。

1a8d0ca45c5e198e.en: Arrange a routine appointment and leave the current deterioration until the scheduled day.
1a8d0ca45c5e198e.zh: 安排普通择期预约，把当前恶化留到预约日处理。

fedbfa29e66e848f.en: Check for a policy as a prerequisite for passing the message to medical workers.
fedbfa29e66e848f.zh: 将核查是否有保单作为向医务人员转达信息的前提。

28d405224b78139f.zh: 信件稍后办，救助须立即

f2fc54648f619a84.en: The original situation was scheduled care. Signs of current deterioration have now appeared: the priority changes, while the ordinary complaint remains a separate case.
f2fc54648f619a84.zh: 原情境涉及择期就诊。现在出现了当前恶化的迹象，因此优先事项改变，但普通投诉仍是独立案件。

26c5de510dc7c63e.en: Assistant: “Without a policy being shown, we first need to find out whether the care will be paid for.”
26c5de510dc7c63e.zh: 助手：“没有出示保单，就得先弄清医疗救助费用有没有人支付。”

eea8a20491ba75b3.en: Compare the identifiers and status using the materials provided.
eea8a20491ba75b3.zh: 依据现有材料核对标识和状态。

256f64df9c4f3678.en: Distinguish the verified request from the unverified link.
256f64df9c4f3678.zh: 区分已核实的请求与未经核实的链接。

5109d79aaa2c6b98.en: Explain the official procedure for communicating with the responsible unit.
5109d79aaa2c6b98.zh: 说明与责任部门联系的正式程序。

7daf1f677c330fe0.en: Do not request the student's real passport details or promise release without checking.
7daf1f677c330fe0.zh: 不索取学生真实护照信息，也不在未核查时承诺放行。

510bd1bd59412697.en: Check that the response specifically concerns МПО-71 and whether the required information has arrived.
510bd1bd59412697.zh: 核查回复是否确实针对МПО-71，以及必要信息是否收到。

fc2cb659af78b738.en: Guarantee immediate release regardless of the information's contents.
fc2cb659af78b738.zh: 不论信息内容如何，都保证立即放行。

5024da03a277b3b0.en: Suggest paying an unverified charge through a personal link.
5024da03a277b3b0.zh: 建议通过私人链接支付未经证实的费用。

64f35f9808fa2a86.en: All participants and documents are fictional. Matching shipment identifiers have been presented, and the training notification's authenticity is verified by the case conditions. Customs release has not yet occurred; clarification of the contents is required. Payment requirements and amounts are not determined in this task. You prepare materials and proposed actions rather than replace an authorised person's decision. The calendar task concerns the authority's formal response, not actual resolution of the problem.
64f35f9808fa2a86.zh: 所有参与者和文件均为虚构。已提供相符的邮件标识，案情确认教学通知真实。尚未完成海关放行，需要补充说明内件信息。本题不确定缴费要求及金额。您准备材料和行动方案，不代替有权人员作出决定。日期计算任务涉及机关的正式回复，而不是实际解决问题的时间。

1adeeebb0b60bd44.en: In the base story, customs release had occurred. Here it has not, so a response only about postal delivery would be premature.
1adeeebb0b60bd44.zh: 基础故事中，海关已经放行。本案尚未放行，因此只回复邮政投递问题还为时过早。

b51c855309ad4929.en: The shipment has arrived for customs processing. There is no release entry. The identifier in the record is МПО-71.
b51c855309ad4929.zh: 邮件已到达海关办理环节，没有放行记录。登记卡中的标识为МПО-71。

cdb671e54abc72c3.en: The conditions confirm authenticity and a link to the shipment. Further details of the contents are requested; the reply channel is in the unit's official record.
cdb671e54abc72c3.zh: 案情确认通知真实且与该邮件相关。要求补充内件信息；回复渠道列在该部门官方资料卡中。

df82e5bff161b2a7.en: A message from an unverified sender demands a transfer to a personal bank card “to speed things up”. No connection to the official request is established.
df82e5bff161b2a7.zh: 发件人未经核实的消息要求向私人银行卡转账以“加快办理”。未证实其与正式请求有关。

ae02ac4b8f1fa021.en: This shipment has not yet been released; work with the verified customs notification is needed. In the base story, customs release had occurred. Here it has not, so a response only about postal delivery would be premature.
ae02ac4b8f1fa021.zh: 该邮件尚未放行，需要依据已核实的海关通知办理。基础故事中，海关已经放行。本案尚未放行，因此只回复邮政投递问题还为时过早。

4e5b41dc5ce6f96a.en: This shipment has not yet been released; work with the verified customs notification is needed.
4e5b41dc5ce6f96a.zh: 该邮件尚未放行，需要依据已核实的海关通知办理。

105f51633d9016cb.en: Any parcel remaining at this stage means the postal service has lost it.
105f51633d9016cb.zh: 包裹只要停留在这一阶段，就说明邮政已经将其遗失。

07c49e9546aadfc8.en: An unverified transfer to a personal card guarantees release.
07c49e9546aadfc8.zh: 向未经核实的私人银行卡转账即可保证放行。

9c61a36df1606526.en: The identifier must also match in the outcome.
9c61a36df1606526.zh: 结果中的标识也必须核对一致。

a6804d96f672a3da.en: A response saying “released” arrived, but it names МПО-17 instead of МПО-71.
a6804d96f672a3da.zh: 收到“已放行”的回复，但标识是МПО-17，而不是МПО-71。

79dde29921f73fa1.en: Clarify the identifier and status of МПО-71; do not close the matter using someone else's record.
79dde29921f73fa1.zh: 核实МПО-71的标识和状态，不凭他人记录结案。

f01c1fe93a6b985a.en: Declare all of the applicant's shipments released.
f01c1fe93a6b985a.zh: 宣布申请人的所有邮件均已放行。

bb571ed357315718.en: Demand payment of the unverified charge again.
bb571ed357315718.zh: 再次要求支付未经证实的费用。

4f6e67c66294e6a9.en: Article 37 of Law No. 176-ФЗ links claims to trace international postal items to Russian legislation and international treaties. Customs-release status does not confirm delivery, and a record with another identifier does not confirm movement of the intended parcel. The postal stage, customs action and a claim against the seller are distinct. These tasks calculate only the public authority's specified action on the submission, not a universal international tracing period.
4f6e67c66294e6a9.zh: 176-ФЗ法律第37条规定，国际邮件查询索赔适用俄罗斯法律和国际条约。海关放行状态不能证明已妥投，其他标识的记录也不能证明目标包裹的流转。邮政阶段、海关行为和向卖家提出的请求应予区分。这些题目仅计算公共机关就来函采取指定行动的期限，不设统一的国际邮件查询期限。

96b439a3d097813a.en: Distinguish the customs stage from a claim to the postal operator; do not establish a universal international tracing period.
96b439a3d097813a.zh: 区分海关阶段与向邮政运营商索赔，不设统一的国际邮件查询期限。

3c9f1574e778d395.en: Treat all international delays as violations by the postal operator.
3c9f1574e778d395.zh: 将所有国际邮件延误都认定为邮政运营商违规。

9c35dfa6f3dbb7d9.en: Equate absence of release with proven loss.
9c35dfa6f3dbb7d9.zh: 将尚未放行等同于已经证实遗失。

8766ffd62b44915b.en: Find the rule: Claims concerning international postal items. Give the instrument's identifying details and article; then select the applicable provision.
8766ffd62b44915b.zh: 查找规定：国际邮件索赔。填写法律文件信息及条文，再选择适用规定。

05359a35d36c7571.en: The postal service said everything is with customs. Last time you advised checking with the operator, but now I have a different notification.
05359a35d36c7571.zh: 邮政说东西都在海关。上次您建议找运营商查询，但这次我收到的是另一种通知。

35b8863b4d063115.en: Clarify the status and procedure for submitting information under the customs notification; respond to the submission.
35b8863b4d063115.zh: 核实状态及按海关通知提交信息的程序，并回复来函。

db1b313e4e27846d.en: Consider only postal tracing of an already released shipment.
db1b313e4e27846d.zh: 只处理已放行邮件的邮政查询。

806edff1d61b5456.en: Recognise a personal payment link as a mandatory government charge.
806edff1d61b5456.zh: 将私人付款链接认定为强制性政府收费。

fa486b3b686aff2c.en: There is a request for clarification, not a release entry.
fa486b3b686aff2c.zh: 是补充信息请求，不是放行记录。

a779e1f70a8c3151.en: What exactly does the notification say?

4a33377d50b81c4d.en: Yes, the parcel and the request both have code МПО-71.
4a33377d50b81c4d.zh: 一致，包裹和请求的代码均为МПО-71。

8ac401f16961f899.en: It is listed in the unit's verified record; I was also sent a third-party link.
8ac401f16961f899.zh: 列在该部门已核实的资料卡中；另有人给我发了第三方链接。

e6310ca54b75f19f.en: Distinguish the verified channel from an unrelated request.
e6310ca54b75f19f.zh: 需要区分已核实渠道与无关请求。

25d98f3782f6a918.en: Is there an official way to submit the information?
25d98f3782f6a918.zh: 是否有提交信息的官方方式？

faf4d872ed0a23fb.en: No, only fictional information is used in the training case.
faf4d872ed0a23fb.zh: 不需要，教学案例仅使用虚构信息。

2c199d92f60ab64e.en: The game does not collect real passport details.
2c199d92f60ab64e.zh: 游戏不收集真实护照信息。

9df7781c9e877dbb.en: Are real personal details needed in the game?
9df7781c9e877dbb.zh: 游戏需要真实个人信息吗？

cae78a9252c0967c.en: The verified customs unit associated with the notification.
cae78a9252c0967c.zh: 与通知相关且已核实的海关部门。

a0c45b8e04a9020b.en: An arbitrary payment recipient from the message.

e701e53c8458d20f.en: A shop in a neighbouring city as a customs-release authority.
e701e53c8458d20f.zh: 将邻市商店当作海关放行机关。

58fa5d797261d1ba.en: The process stage and the document's relevance change the route.
58fa5d797261d1ba.zh: 流程阶段及文件关联性改变办理路径。

5338f088e1f0a95a.en: If release is unconfirmed, the conclusion from a case involving a parcel already handed to the postal operator cannot be transferred here.
5338f088e1f0a95a.zh: 放行尚未证实时，不能套用包裹已交邮政运营商案例的结论。

9540e34c572e77da.en: Compare the identifier, delivery report and substance of the claim.
9540e34c572e77da.zh: 核对标识、妥投记录及请求内容。

b2353c3fe111192c.en: Separate confirmed damage from responsibility that has not yet been established.
b2353c3fe111192c.zh: 区分已证实的损坏与尚未确定的责任。

5b1e81e6803a72a9.en: Prepare the correct route and a list of the materials already available.
5b1e81e6803a72a9.zh: 准备正确办理路径及已有材料清单。

28990872408eb03e.en: Do not require redelivery as the only way to make a claim, and do not promise an amount.
28990872408eb03e.zh: 不将再次投递作为提出索赔的唯一方式，也不承诺赔偿金额。

70e2ccb6c5c752bc.en: Check that damage and missing contents were considered, not just delivery status.
70e2ccb6c5c752bc.zh: 核查是否审查了损坏和短少，而不仅仅是妥投状态。

7490f50abe2c38ce.en: Close the matter solely on the release entry.

48275aa17534fa7b.en: Find a particular employee at fault without the necessary evidence.
48275aa17534fa7b.zh: 没有必要证据就认定具体员工有过错。

3fa48cca61fdbc0f.en: All participants and documents are fictional. Customs release and subsequent delivery are confirmed. There is a delivery damage report and an inventory, but the responsible party and extent of liability are not established. International tracing is not reduced to a general thirty-day period. You prepare materials and proposed actions rather than replace an authorised person's decision. The calendar task concerns the authority's formal response, not actual resolution of the problem.
3fa48cca61fdbc0f.zh: 所有参与者和文件均为虚构。海关放行及后续妥投已证实。有投递时的损坏记录和物品清单，但责任人及责任范围尚未确定。国际邮件查询不能简单套用一般三十日期限。您准备材料和行动方案，不代替有权人员作出决定。日期计算任务涉及机关的正式回复，而不是实际解决问题的时间。

306af9f9eb9e5eb8.en: In the base situation, the parcel is still in transit. Here delivery is complete, but a different claim has arisen; the old explanation does not resolve it.
306af9f9eb9e5eb8.zh: 基础情境中，包裹仍在运输。本案已完成投递，但出现了不同请求；旧说明不能解决它。

4363e607a0f53dd5.en: The old response explains when the shipment entered the country. It does not investigate its condition on delivery.
4363e607a0f53dd5.zh: 旧回复说明邮件何时入境，未调查投递时的状况。

fc92a8230ff29ad1.en: The shipment was delivered. Packaging damage was recorded at delivery; the report identifies МПО-93 and includes an inventory of the contents found.
fc92a8230ff29ad1.zh: 邮件已妥投。投递时记录了包装损坏；记录标明МПО-93，并附有发现的内件清单。

037dbd0630803e4a.en: The customs unit's response confirms release of МПО-93. The new claim concerns damage and missing contents during delivery, not cancellation of release.
037dbd0630803e4a.zh: 海关部门回复确认МПО-93已放行。新请求涉及投递中的损坏和短少，而非撤销放行。

a77859c79dffd46a.en: Customs release does not answer the new claim about damage and missing contents on delivery. In the base situation, the parcel is still in transit. Here delivery is complete, but a different claim has arisen; the old explanation does not resolve it.
a77859c79dffd46a.zh: 海关放行不能答复关于投递时损坏和短少的新请求。基础情境中，包裹仍在运输。本案已完成投递，但出现了不同请求；旧说明不能解决它。

eae31beab2cb864e.en: Customs release does not answer the new claim about damage and missing contents on delivery.
eae31beab2cb864e.zh: 海关放行不能答复关于投递时损坏和短少的新请求。

c837c834458587d4.en: Release proves that subsequent delivery was flawless.
c837c834458587d4.zh: 放行证明后续投递毫无问题。

2df29584be158f6a.en: Damage automatically establishes a particular employee's fault.
2df29584be158f6a.zh: 发生损坏就自动确定具体员工有过错。

2199a46a4781c74a.en: Follow-up concerns a complete response on damage, not another delivery-status update.
2199a46a4781c74a.zh: 跟踪检查关注损坏问题的完整答复，而不是再次更新投递状态。

d7f6342c2be5f693.en: The operator replied about delivery time but did not mention the damage report or inventory.
d7f6342c2be5f693.zh: 运营商回复了投递时间，却未提损坏记录和清单。

040abc6e20667463.en: Check completeness of review of the new subject and request a specific clarification.
040abc6e20667463.zh: 检查新事项是否得到完整审查，并要求具体补充说明。

3e41c6dbe59f63b8.en: Treat any operator response as complete.
3e41c6dbe59f63b8.zh: 将运营商的任何回复都视为完整。

64fc38ce0739babe.en: Delete the report so that it does not contradict the brief response.
64fc38ce0739babe.zh: 删除记录，以免与简短回复矛盾。

846ca20f36934b1a.en: Apply the postal claims procedure to the specific subject and international shipment.
846ca20f36934b1a.zh: 针对具体事项及国际邮件适用邮政索赔程序。

b4c74f646c8d243c.en: Infer absence of liability solely from release status.
b4c74f646c8d243c.zh: 仅从放行状态推断不存在责任。

faca6807af3aeadf.en: Set a uniform thirty-day international tracing period without a legal basis.
faca6807af3aeadf.zh: 无法律依据地设定统一的三十日国际查询期限。

f328398d9654e60b.en: I have the parcel now, but the packaging is damaged and some contents are missing. They only tell me that customs released everything.
f328398d9654e60b.zh: 包裹现在到我手里了，但包装破损，部分物品不见了。他们却只说海关已经全部放行。

ecd987865ca78784.en: Distinguish the new claim's subject and the applicable postal procedure.
ecd987865ca78784.zh: 明确新索赔事项及适用邮政程序。

5a54a48d5e9983af.en: Continue investigating only the reasons for customs release that is already complete.
5a54a48d5e9983af.zh: 继续只调查已经完成的海关放行原因。

474fb0af8fe8be25.en: Award compensation without checking carriage terms or liability.
474fb0af8fe8be25.zh: 不核查运输条件和责任就决定赔偿。

9f5797bba35d1ac5.en: The subject is no longer simply non-delivery.

92f2e7f451e0458f.en: Has the parcel already been delivered?

000b20b7bdb606bf.en: A report was drawn up at delivery; it is attached.
000b20b7bdb606bf.zh: 投递时作了记录，已附上。

81a3f847f00e2958.en: Relevant materials on the packaging's condition are available.
81a3f847f00e2958.zh: 有关于包装状况的相关材料。

fdeb28f216f438d7.en: Only completion of release, not safe delivery.
fdeb28f216f438d7.zh: 仅证明完成放行，不证明投递完好。

432db66911deeadb.en: Release does not resolve the damage claim.
432db66911deeadb.zh: 放行不能解决损坏索赔。

cd8e1545046901fc.en: What does the customs response confirm?

ecddbc5158679604.en: Investigate the damage and missing contents, and explain the next procedure.
ecddbc5158679604.zh: 核查损坏和短少，并解释后续程序。

a82486f102f7b139.en: A claim-specific review is needed without assigning fault in advance.
a82486f102f7b139.zh: 需要针对具体请求处理，不预先认定过错。

0c87da18a6ece970.zh: 负责邮政服务来函的接待专员

2dded4f6c60ad068.en: Explain the postal operator's claims route and the limits of the authority's remit.
2dded4f6c60ad068.zh: 解释邮政运营商的索赔途径及机关权限边界。

87b6a8845ef3d6fe.en: Require customs to compensate independently for any missing contents.
87b6a8845ef3d6fe.zh: 要求海关自行赔偿任何短少。

cb78600852726095.en: Oblige an arbitrary courier to accept the claimed amount.
cb78600852726095.zh: 要求随意一名快递员认可索赔金额。

7cdf8c70de63584a.en: Delivery, condition and liability are distinct matters to check.
7cdf8c70de63584a.zh: 投递、完好程度及责任是不同的核查事项。

382f1c214aeb2146.en: A “delivered” entry alone does not resolve a claim about the parcel's condition on delivery.
382f1c214aeb2146.zh: 仅有“已妥投”记录，不能解决对投递时包裹状况的索赔。

f2c36c30e7f030f1.en: Compare the latest tracking events with the submission's subject
f2c36c30e7f030f1.zh: 核对最新物流事件与来函事项

a7457e775bf139d6.en: Separate the postal issue from customs actions
a7457e775bf139d6.zh: 区分邮政问题与海关行为

33923b8cf4e0bf83.en: Prepare forwarding to the competent authority and explain contacting the operator
33923b8cf4e0bf83.zh: 准备转交有权机关，并说明如何联系运营商

c5ed4992434e706f.en: Notify the applicant of forwarding without disclosing unnecessary recipient data
c5ed4992434e706f.zh: 通知申请人转交情况，不披露多余的收件人数据

d24becb451a8c199.en: Check that the postal-delay issue was forwarded, not a different dispute
d24becb451a8c199.zh: 核查转交的是邮政延误问题，而非其他争议

c336222f03e437b3.en: Demand an additional duty without established grounds
c336222f03e437b3.zh: 无既定依据地要求额外关税

49b638c8c792c720.en: 59-ФЗ, Article 8. The calculation rules are separately fixed by the conditions; this period is not a repair deadline.
49b638c8c792c720.zh: 59-ФЗ，第8条。计算规则由题目条件另行规定；该期限不是维修期限。

4217002ef700d99e.en: Final day for forwarding the oversight issue
4217002ef700d99e.zh: 转交监管事项的最后一天

057efc69865037ef.en: Release authorised → received for postal processing. The alleged subsequent delay is after release. The timeline does not prove loss or identify a person at fault.
057efc69865037ef.zh: 准予放行→进入邮政处理。反映的后续延误发生在放行之后。时间线不能证明遗失，也不能确定过错人。

e6ba60a01182bbe8.en: International shipment. Tracing requires checking the applicable rules and contract; it is not assigned a universal period for all domestic shipments.
e6ba60a01182bbe8.zh: 国际邮件。查询须核查适用规则和合同，不能套用所有国内邮件的统一期限。

3a5825eb52a63d26.en: Check the postal stage and tracing procedure; the tracking does not support blaming customs.
3a5825eb52a63d26.zh: 应核查邮政阶段和查询程序；物流追踪不支持归责海关。

6631f5daecde0929.en: Any international delay means unlawful detention by customs.
6631f5daecde0929.zh: 任何国际邮件延误都意味着海关非法扣留。

698764702d0b2ed6.en: Release proves delivery to the addressee.
698764702d0b2ed6.zh: 放行证明已交付收件人。

4cb4b42306f85d1d.en: The operator reports delivery but gives a different shipment number.
4cb4b42306f85d1d.zh: 运营商报告已投递，但列出的是另一个邮件编号。

8ececc67317f894c.en: Compare the identifiers; another parcel's result does not close this matter.
8ececc67317f894c.zh: 核对标识；另一个包裹的结果不能使本事项结案。

857db3e46971c50a.en: Accept the operator's response without cross-checking.
857db3e46971c50a.zh: 不核对就认可运营商回复。

a66be849a4550bbb.en: Article 37 of Law No. 176-ФЗ specifically refers to Russian legislation and international treaties for claims concerning international shipments. After confirmed release, the postal stage must be checked. The calendar task calculates forwarding of a submission by an authority, not parcel delivery time or the period for every international claim.
a66be849a4550bbb.zh: 176-ФЗ法律第37条专门规定，国际邮件索赔适用俄罗斯法律和国际条约。确认放行后，应核查邮政阶段。日期计算题计算的是机关转交来函的期限，而不是包裹投递时间或所有国际索赔的期限。

7b8455668ced2b78.en: Find the provision on claims concerning international shipments.
7b8455668ced2b78.zh: 查找国际邮件索赔的规定。

5cfce90026bca32c.en: My parcel from abroad is not moving. A forum says customs holds everything for months. Tracking shows “release authorised” and then postal processing.
5cfce90026bca32c.zh: 国外寄来的包裹不动了。论坛说海关什么都扣几个月。物流记录有“准予放行”，之后是邮政处理。

bd1a17b72e5f747f.en: Distinguish a customs submission from a claim concerning international postal services
bd1a17b72e5f747f.zh: 区分海关来函与国际邮政服务索赔

c794514ca3c0f5db.en: Automatically apply 30 days to all international tracing
c794514ca3c0f5db.zh: 自动对所有国际查询适用30日期限

0116c837921efa9a.en: Customs release is complete; afterwards the shipment was accepted by the postal operator.
0116c837921efa9a.zh: 海关放行已完成，之后邮件由邮政运营商接收。

ed324ae8714e5a1c.en: The latest established stage does not concern a customs decision.
ed324ae8714e5a1c.zh: 最新已查明阶段不涉及海关决定。

9d1f88f2adad02bb.en: No, the attached tracking contains no such event.
9d1f88f2adad02bb.zh: 没有，所附物流记录没有该事件。

aef6e6576f92dc39.en: Missing customs documents must not be invented.
aef6e6576f92dc39.zh: 不能虚构缺少海关文件的情况。

33c85f7005777dca.en: Is there a notification requesting customs documents?
33c85f7005777dca.zh: 是否有要求海关文件的通知？

468092f47ebcafd2.en: No, so far the applicant has written only to customs.
468092f47ebcafd2.zh: 没有，目前申请人只写信给海关。

9df4b75777fda5c2.en: The claim/tracing route must be explained.
9df4b75777fda5c2.zh: 需要说明索赔及查询途径。

5d674c1aa03060b4.en: Has tracing with the operator begun?
5d674c1aa03060b4.zh: 是否已向运营商申请查询？

639c6be8a0145a62.en: Yes; the type and international route are stated on the receipt.
639c6be8a0145a62.zh: 是的，凭证注明邮件类别及国际运输路线。

0896f3114cd466ea.en: Special conditions cannot be replaced by the period for any domestic parcel.
0896f3114cd466ea.zh: 不能用任意国内包裹期限代替特殊条件。

f823ca89896909fe.en: Checks whether there is a customs issue without replacing the postal operator. The case establishes that oversight of the delay outside customs is within the communications regulator's authority.
f823ca89896909fe.zh: 核查是否存在海关事项，不代替邮政运营商。案情已确定，海关环节之外延误的监管问题属于通信监管机关权限。

fcf2249af4baccb7.en: Explain how to contact the operator and forward the oversight matter outside your authority to the established addressee, with notification.
fcf2249af4baccb7.zh: 说明如何联系运营商，将超出本机关权限的监管事项转交既定受理人，并予以通知。

a52970a884cde176.en: Close the submission as proven delivery.
a52970a884cde176.zh: 以已证实妥投为由关闭来函。

22539d2c256a5746.en: Check the special rules for international claims; do not promise a delivery time instead of the procedural deadline.
22539d2c256a5746.zh: 核查国际索赔特别规则；不要将程序期限说成投递时间并作出承诺。
